blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a condo in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for apartments (condos) in Port Coquitlam was $550,000 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did condo prices fall in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 9.0%. Over three months it fell 5.6%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Port Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the condos in Port Coquitlam that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when condos come up in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Port Coquitlam homes?
faq.a: The Port Coquitlam homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Port Coquitlam market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.
